gloss: to bring close together; to reconcile; to align

definitions.gloss: to bring close together; to press together
definitions.explanation: To physically bring two things close together so they touch or are side by side.

definitions.gloss: to reconcile; to align; to bring into agreement
definitions.explanation: To bring differing opinions, positions, or numbers into alignment. Commonly used in business and negotiations to describe the process of reconciling differences.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{体|からだ}を{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せてきた。
examples.english: The cat pressed its body against me.

examples.japanese: {頬|ほお}を{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せて{甘|あま}える{子|こ}ども。
examples.english: A child snuggling their cheek close and acting affectionately.

examples.japanese: {両手|りょうて}を{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せて{暖|あたた}めた。
examples.english: I rubbed my hands together to warm them.

examples.japanese: {意見|いけん}を{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to reconcile our opinions.

examples.japanese: {双方|そうほう}の{条件|じょうけん}を{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せて{合意|ごうい}に{達|たっ}した。
examples.english: We reached an agreement by bringing both sides' conditions into alignment.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}と{実績|じっせき}の{数字|すうじ}を{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる{作業|さぎょう}に{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time to reconcile the budget and actual figures.

notes:
Combines {擦|す}る (to rub) and {寄|よ}せる (to bring near). The physical sense of rubbing or pressing close extends to a figurative meaning of reconciling or aligning differences. Also written with the kanji {摺|す}り{寄|よ}せる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体|からだ}を{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる: to press one's body close
- {意見|いけん}を{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる: to reconcile opinions
- {数字|すうじ}を{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる: to reconcile figures
- {立場|たちば}を{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる: to bring positions into alignment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {擦|す}り{寄|よ}る: to sidle up to — intransitive version; the subject moves close, rather than bringing things together
- {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}る: to compromise, to meet halfway — emphasizes mutual concession
- すり{合|あ}わせる: to coordinate, to compare and adjust — used for schedules, documents, and detailed alignment
